verdict.rationale: Ashby documents an AI feature that scans and matches existing candidates against job criteria and surfaces signals (ashby-docs-1), showing the screening/matching capability exists, but there is no vendor documentation of how the matching algorithm works internally or what safeguards (bias mitigation, human-review requirements, audit logging) apply to these automated decisions. Community evidence further shows a candidate-facing opt-out from AI resume processing was broken in practice (ashby-comm-7), undermining trust in any implied safeguard. Missing for 10: detailed explanation of the matching model/methodology, documented bias/fairness safeguards, and a working, verifiable opt-out or human-oversight mechanism for automated screening decisions.
